Subject: Week status + QBR artifacts request — OKR alignment & asks

Good morning team,

Short read — wins, current risks, and 3 asks ahead of next week's QBR. Keeping this tight so we can pull artifact-level items into the pack.

Wins:
- Infra autoscaler hit the throughput SLA in Prod for 48h during the East region load test; unit cost below our Q2 target.
- Redwood Optimize pilot for two mid-market customers reduced token spend by ~18% in the trial cohort.

Risks / open concerns:
- Dedicated capacity rollout: 1 critical firmware image for the GPU nodes failed cert on the staging fleet; holds up one customer's Dedicated launch if not resolved by Thursday.
- QBR metrics — we currently lack a clean per-model latency percentile chart for the hosted API exports (p95 by model) — Ops is working but it might be late for the slide deck.

Asks (actionable):
1) Laura — can you pull a one-slide impact summary of the Dedicated customer who would be affected if the firmware delay slips past Thu EOD? Need a revenue and SLO impact row. Target: EOD Wed. (attachment: QBR_one-pager-v2.pdf)
2) Karthik — please confirm whether the p95 chart can be bound to an alternate metric (p90 + error rate) if the p95 feed is not cleaned by Wed 5pm. Reply yes/no and which alternate metric we should show.
3) Marissa — consolidate the open security/compliance asks from Acme (they replied below) and flag anything requiring executive sign-off.

I'll be on standby for any clarifying notes. If anyone wants to swap a slide, I'll take the Dedicated impact slide.

Diego
VP, Platform Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: QBR_one-pager-v2.pdf (PDF, 420KB), OKR-trimmed-dashboard.png (PNG, 120KB)
